gloss: to resell; to scalp; to flip

definitions.gloss: to resell; to scalp; to flip
definitions.explanation: To buy something and sell it again, typically at a higher price for profit. In modern Japanese, carries a strongly negative connotation due to association with ticket scalping and hoarding of limited goods.

examples.japanese: チケットを{転売|てんばい}する。
{限定品|げんていひん}を{高値|たかね}で{転売|てんばい}する{人|ひと}がいる。
examples.english: There are people who resell limited items at high prices.

examples.japanese: {転売|てんばい}{目的|もくてき}での{購入|こうにゅう}はご{遠慮|えんりょ}ください。
examples.english: Please refrain from purchasing for resale purposes.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}コンサートのチケットが{定価|ていか}の{何倍|なんばい}もの{値段|ねだん}で{転売|てんばい}されている。
examples.english: Popular concert tickets are being resold at many times the original price.

notes:
Has become a hot social topic in Japan. {転売|てんばい}{屋|や} (resellers/scalpers) are widely criticized for buying up concert tickets, limited-edition goods, and even daily necessities during shortages. Japan passed a law in 2019 specifically banning ticket resale ({チケット不正転売禁止法|ちけっとふせいてんばいきんしほう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転売|てんばい}{屋|や}: scalper, reseller
- {転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}: resale prohibited
- {転売|てんばい}{目的|もくてき}: for resale purposes
- {高額|こうがく}{転売|てんばい}: selling at inflated prices
- {不正|ふせい}{転売|てんばい}: illegal resale

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {売|う}る: to sell — neutral, general selling
- {横流|よこなが}しする: to divert goods — selling through unofficial channels
- {中古|ちゅうこ}で{売|う}る: to sell second-hand — selling used items, neutral connotation
